entry.title: YMCA of Douglas County Opens Youth Basketball Registration November 2
entry.summary: Registration for the YMCA of Douglas County's Youth Basketball League opens November 2 at 8 a.m. Children ages 3 through fourth grade can participate, with games beginning in January. Volunteer coaches are also needed.

entry.title: Pass Creek Covered Bridge in Drain Added to National Register of Historic Places
entry.summary: The Pass Creek Covered Bridge in Drain has been added to the National Register of Historic Places. Built in 1925, the bridge is recognized for its engineering significance and is among fewer than 50 historic covered bridges remaining in Oregon.

entry.title: Douglas County Voter Participation Reaches 41.25% Ahead of November 3 Election
entry.summary: Douglas County voter participation has reached 41.25%, with 36,893 ballots received ahead of the November 3 election. Participation is running 3.10 percentage points ahead of the same point in 2022.

entry.title: Douglas County Courthouse to Shine Green in November for Veterans
entry.summary: Douglas County will light the courthouse green throughout November for Operation Green Light, recognizing veterans and their families. Residents and businesses are invited to participate by placing a green bulb in an exterior light.

entry.title: Douglas County joins nationwide effort to honor veterans
entry.summary: Douglas County will light up the courthouse in green throughout November to honor veterans and raise awareness of challenges they face returning to civilian life.

entry.title: Roseburg Schools Plans Three Free Literacy Nights for Families With Young Children
entry.summary: Roseburg Schools will host three free literacy nights for families with children ages 2 to 4. The series begins November 16 with Pancakes & Pajamas at Winchester Elementary. Registration is required, and children do not need to be enrolled in the district.

entry.title: Three Killed After Two Helicopters Collide Near McMinnville Airport
entry.summary: Three people were killed Thursday afternoon when two helicopters collided in midair near McMinnville Municipal Airport. Authorities identified two victims, including a 22-year-old flight instructor and a 38-year-old pilot. Federal investigators are examining the crash.
